author: Cheyenne Ubiera
title: Gavin Newsom posts savage video mocking Trump's bruised hand and public blunders - NewsBreak
text:
By Cheyenne Ubiera ,
4 hours ago Gavin Newsom 's online feud with Donald Trump continues after he posted a scathing video of the president's bruised hand online.
The governor
The clip pulled together some of Trump's most embarrassing blunders in the public eye, such as tripping on the steps of Air Force One, cringing from an eagle, and being bumped on the chin by a reporter's microphone .
READ MORE: Trump's attempt to dismiss health concerns seriously backfires as new theories grow
READ MORE: 'Unsteady' Trump, 79, is 'reaching' for Melania's support as he gets older
"We talking hands? " read the post's caption.
The 2001 song, made famous from McEntire's hit sitcom, Reba, drew an ironic twist from Trump's gold-plated lifestyle with lyrics about a "single mom who works two jobs." The video also drew s pecial attention to the bruises seen on Trump's hand in recent months .
The president was recently diagnosed with chronic venous insufficiency (CVI), but rumors regarding his health had swirled long before that. White House Press Secretary Karoline Leavitt has tried to dismiss the welts seen on Trump's hand, blaming it on the president's diplomatic handshaking.
"President Trump is a man of the people, and he meets more Americans and shakes their hands on a daily basis than any other President in history," Leavitt said last month. "His commitment is unwavering, and he proves that every single day."
Texas Representative Ronny Jackson, who formerly served as the president's physician, called Trump "the healthiest president this nation has ever seen" last week as Americans continued to grow concerned about his bizarre absences.
Newsom's latest clapback comes after Trump called the governor a "very incompetent guy," while speaking to reporters in the Oval Office.
"I watch him with the hands. What's going on with his hands? There's something wrong with him," said Trump.
Over the last month, Newsom has mocked the president on social media , using his GovPressOffice X account to boast about himself in all-caps, similar to how Trump writes on Truth Social. In a recent post, Newsom responded to Trump posting "GOOD NIGHT!!!" with the response: "Night night grandpa!"
Trump was able to resist the bait for several weeks before eventually ranting about Newsom on August 20, writing, "Gavin Newscum is way down in the polls. He is viewed as the man who is destroying the once Great State of California."
Newsom shared that Trump's team has attempted to troll him back by sending "Trump 2028" red baseball caps, but the governor returned fire with his own "Newsom 2026" mugs and "Newsom was right about everything!" hats .
